column4: Thermal Runaway during 1000VDC Fast-Charging (Coolant pump failure or cell overcharge).
column7: Redundant RTD thermal sensors on cooling loop; shunt breaker trips 480VAC grid if temp ≥ 60°C in <50 ms.

column4: Inadvertent Aircraft Takeoff During Battery Extraction (Premature taxi with arm engaged).
column7: Hardwired 24VDC interlock (ICD-IF-006); mechanical latch sensor prevents avionics throttle arming while arm is mated.

column4: Passenger Exposure to High Rotor Downwash (Gate door opened during active hover/taxi).
column7: Solenoid gate lock (SKY-REQ-014); gates de-energized until rotor RPM = 0. Blast fencing redirects downwash < 20 knots.

column4: Arc Flash during Docking/Undocking (Contactors disconnected under live 1000A load).
column7: Pre-charge contactor sequencing; pilot interlock verifies zero current flow before mechanical pin release.

column4: Software Freeze During Emergency Power-Off (EPO) (Supervisory OS hang under fault).
column7: Completely hardwired, normally closed (NC) 24VDC relay circuit (SKY-REQ-011) bypassing OS; opens grid breakers in <20 ms.

column2: RPN = Severity x Occurence x Detection
column7:
RAC                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Severity Categories (Roman Numerals I to IV):
• Catastrophic (I): Death, permanent total disability, or system loss.
• Critical (II): Severe injury, major system damage, or significant delay.
• Marginal (III): Minor injury, minor system damage.
• Negligible (IV): Less than minor injury or system degradation.
2. Probability Levels (Letters A to E):
• Frequent (A) → Probable (B) → Occasional (C) → Remote (D) → Improbable (E).
3. The Resulting RAC Score:
• High (RAC 1-2) (unacceptable without sign-off), Serious (RAC 3), Medium, to Low (RAC 4-5).
